learning_outcomes.text: To be able to read and understand a reading passage appropriate to the level.
To be able to use verbs frequently used in daily conversations in sentences.
To learn about the geographical structure of Germany, and to learn city and country names in Europe.
To be able to introduce oneself and greet.
To learn about living conditions and educational structure in Germany.
To be able to understand and express cultural differences.

syllabus_topics: Alphabet and letter groups in German, accentuation in pronunciation
Geography knowledge, European countries and international words
Personal and interrogative pronouns, accusative case
Possessive pronoun, weekly lesson plan and lessons
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
